pairs.summary: GATA1::TAL1 and MGA::EVX1 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 6 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; HepG2 hepatoblastoma/liver cancer; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; MDA-MB-468 triple-negative breast cancer; ...). Median lift 1.29x, typical spacing ~55 bp between sites. In 6 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: dimer motif — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
